title: A report is a list of lines. A reader needs a run of time.

beats.narration: A report arrives as a list of lines. The reader rebuilds the order in their head. The output-surfaces audit starts there: passive surfaces still default to plain prose.
Lavish already ships the parts. Export inlines audio, video and captions. The marketing folder already renders an HTML and GSAP timeline to MP4, with local text to speech.
What is missing is instruction. No playbook tells an agent to build a narrated timeline, so the parts stay unconnected.
One playbook closes the gap. Read the source, write the beats, narrate the beats, render the timeline. No second renderer, no queue, no service.
Timing comes from the narration itself. Each beat records how long its audio runs, and the next beat starts after it. Change a sentence and the visuals move with it.
Open lavish axi playbook explainer to build the first one. The example in this repository explains the audit you just watched.
